resources.string: Allow command input on this channel
Compare this fingerprint with your server before trusting it. A changed key is rejected.
Recent output from the original pane. This preview does not stream the full terminal grid or claim exclusive input control.
A foreground service uses a persistent notification and may consume more power. Android can still terminate the process. Local shells cannot survive force-stop.
A task needs your attention or has completed.
The computer needs a reachable SSH server and a running Pebrel build with mobile-bridge on PATH. Windows, Linux and macOS use the same channel protocol.
Connection preview: local and SSH terminals, LAN and relay QR pairing, and bounded desktop output. Durable notification replay, desktop file transfer and WebDAV are not available yet.
Start your relay and the desktop connector, then paste the contents of phone-DEVICE.txt here. Your relay must have a valid HTTPS certificate.
This preview uses your relay as a trusted endpoint: its operator can access session data. Credentials are stored using Android Keystore. Input requires --allow-input on the computer.
No open sessions yet. Connect a host or open a local terminal.
No saved hosts. Tap + to add an SSH host.
Connect a computer to continue your Pebrel sessions.
Remove %1$s from saved hosts? Open sessions will keep running.
Verify the host fingerprint on first connection. Passwords can be saved on this device.
Connection is unavailable. Return to Computers to reconnect.
Tap the terminal to type directly
Local command prefixes only. Suggestions never execute a command.
Font changes apply to terminal output. Layout follows system text scaling.
The terminal uses the selected theme background. Image backgrounds are not available yet.
Compose edits locally before sending. Direct input is for interactive terminal programs.
Desktop file transfer, WebDAV and structured reading are not available yet.
Online desktop task updates use system notifications. Offline replay is not available yet.
Paired computers are saved on this device. Tap a saved computer to reconnect. Version 2 connections use end-to-end encryption.
Close %1$s? This ends the terminal connection and its local process.
Pebrel for Android · Local terminals and SSH connections.
Leave the password blank for Tailscale SSH or another server-approved passwordless login. Other SSH servers may require a password.
Password login. Key files are not supported yet.
Choose Save password to keep it encrypted on this device.
The remote session has ended. Output remains available to read.
Connecting to the server and negotiating an encrypted channel…
Waiting for your confirmation of the host fingerprint…
The host address could not be resolved. Check the address and DNS connection.
The server did not respond in time. Check the address, port and network, then retry.
Could not connect to the SSH port. Check the SSH service, port and firewall.
Authentication failed. Check the username and password, and whether the server allows password login.
The host fingerprint has changed. Connection was blocked. Verify the server identity before removing and adding this host again.
The host fingerprint was not confirmed, or confirmation timed out. Reconnect to verify it again.
The server could not open the terminal channel. Check shell access for this account.
The SSH connection was interrupted. Check the network and reconnect. Commands will not be resent automatically.
SSH channel negotiation failed. Check that this is an SSH port and that the server supports current SSH algorithms.
Could not open this terminal. Retry or check the host configuration.
The SSH cryptographic component failed to initialize on this device. Update the app and retry.
Markdown, source code, text and images open as shared tabs.
Close “%1$s” on the computer? This removes the shared tab from both devices.
A task is still running in this tab. Confirm its closure on the computer.
This file has unsaved changes. Save or close it on the computer first.
The computer is still saving or closing this tab. Try again when it finishes.
Update Pebrel on the computer to manage and read shared file tabs.
Copy failed. Select a smaller section and try again.
The file changed on the computer. Refresh to read the latest content.
Disconnected · showing the content already loaded
The computer is disconnected. Reconnect to continue.
The file has not loaded. Check its state on the computer and retry.
This file exceeds the 16 MiB reader limit. Open it on the computer.
This tab or file type has no mobile reader.
Image decoding failed. Check the image format and file on the computer.
This link did not open. Use an HTTP link or a local file path.
Long content is limited here. View the full output in the terminal.
Messages will appear here when this Agent writes its conversation.
Answer this interaction in the terminal
Update the computer app to use conversation view.
This Agent session ended or changed. Return to the terminal and reopen its conversation.
Waiting for a Codex or Claude Code conversation file reported by this pane. Continue in the terminal while it is being identified.
The conversation is updating. Refreshing its current messages.
The recent-history cache is full. View older history in the terminal.
The question changed. Review its current options before answering.
The Agent is working or awaiting an interaction. Your draft is kept.
No receipt was received. Your draft is kept; check the terminal before sending it again.
Delete “%1$s” from this host? Only this file, link or empty folder will be removed.
Some names contain unsupported control characters or exceed the path limit.
This path no longer exists. Refresh the folder or check the path.
The host denied this file operation. Check the account permissions.
The destination already exists. Choose a different name; existing files are kept.
SFTP is not enabled on this host. The terminal remains available.
This file or directory view changed. Refresh before continuing.
SSH is disconnected. Return to the terminal to reconnect.
The file request timed out. Check the connection and retry.
The current file-view limit was reached. Close a transfer or open a smaller folder.
Preview supports files up to 16 MiB. Download this file to read it on your device.
This file is not a supported UTF-8 text or image preview. Download it to open on your device.
The device file provider did not complete the operation. Choose the file or destination again.
Enter a valid path or name. Names must not contain slashes or control characters.
The operation did not finish. Check the path, permissions and whether the folder is empty.
Use the address shown in the computer’s Phone Remote settings. Pairing and permissions stay unchanged. The address is saved after connecting successfully.
Enter a valid computer address and port.
